items.item:
12. An accepted import stores every picked project with its rooms and
    pointers, the Customers it made, one closure holding the file's digest and
    exactly one audit entry; a failure inside its transaction leaves none of
    them — no project, room, pointer, Customer, closure or entry.
   Shows A16-1. [witness: verification:registry_a16_accepted_import_stores_all_in_one_transaction]

verdicts.why: The check verifies the accepted import's picked projects, rooms, pointers, generated Customer, digest-bearing singleton closure, and singleton audit entry. It also injects a failure at the final audit-entry write and verifies refusal plus rollback to the prior snapshot and emptiness of every imported table, with no readable picked projects or Customers remaining.
